strategy: Use a scoped git revert on a dedicated human-reviewed rollback branch; never rewrite adopted Architecture or historical evidence.
steps: Keep OA-01 and later successors blocked while rollback is evaluated.
Create a dedicated rollback branch from the then-current protected base.
Revert OA-00C commits in reverse order without force-push or history rewrite.
Preserve Architecture Freeze v1.1/v1.2, ADR-001 through ADR-030, adoption manifests, task graphs, and all historical evidence.
Re-run canonical, cross-repository, consumer, JSON, Markdown, diff, scope, and lifecycle validation.
Open a Draft rollback PR and stop for human checkpoint.
